keyEvents.text: Trai Hume (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Aston Villa 0, Sunderland 0.
Second Half begins Aston Villa 0, Sunderland 0.
Leon Goretzka (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Aston Villa. John McGinn replaces Johan Manzambi.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Ibrahim Mbaye replaces Emiliano Buendía.
Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
